missing_aspects: Statutory provision defining indecent assault using a victim’s unconscious state as an offense under the Special Act on Punishment of Sexual Violence
coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision stating that indecent acts using a victim’s unconscious state constitute aggravated indecent assault under the Special Act on Punishment of Sexual Violence. None of the supplied provisions define the offense elements or incorporate unconsciousness as an aggravating factor; C007 and C008 concern victim privacy and procedural care, not offense elements.

missing_aspects: Provision explicitly permitting punishment of attempted aggravated indecent assault under the Special Act on Punishment of Sexual Violence
coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision explicitly permitting punishment of attempted aggravated indecent assault. The supplied attempt provisions (C011–C020) are generic or statute-specific but none reference the Special Act’s aggravated indecent assault offense or its attempt; therefore no provision satisfies the criteria.

missing_aspects: Statutory penalty provision for aggravated indecent assault under the Special Act on Punishment of Sexual Violence
coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision specifying the statutory penalty (imprisonment/fine) for aggravated indecent assault. None of the supplied provisions set penalties for this offense; they address procedural dismissal, victim privacy, or unrelated attempt rules.
